title: Staff Product Manager - Agency Revenue Growth
description:
About us
HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.
To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently. Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.

Our people
With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our impact
Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact.
We’re proud to be a part of that.Learn more about us on ourYouTube Channel orBlog Posts

Role Overview
As the Staff Product Manager for Agency Revenue Growth, you will own the vision, strategy, and outcomes for HighLevel's Agency Revenue Suite. Your mission is to help agencies launch, grow, and scale successful SaaS businesses by creating seamless experiences across SaaS Mode, Reselling, Rebilling, and the broader agency revenue ecosystem.This role requires a strong blend of product strategy, growth expertise, customer empathy, and analytical rigor. You will drive measurable improvements in onboarding, activation, adoption, retention, and agency revenue while establishing the systems, metrics, and experimentation frameworks that enable sustainable growth at scale.You will work closely with Engineering, Design, Data Science, Analytics, Marketing, Revenue, and Customer Success teams to identify opportunities, align priorities, and deliver measurable business impact.

Key Responsibilities
  • Own the strategy, roadmap, and business outcomes for the Agency Revenue Suite, driving growth across SaaS Mode, Reselling, Rebilling, and the overall agency revenue experience.
  • Create a unified experience that enables agencies to launch, monetize, and scale successful SaaS businesses on HighLevel.
  • Define and own the measurement strategy for the Agency Revenue Suite, including instrumentation, reporting, customer health frameworks, and key SaaS metrics across activation, adoption, retention, expansion, churn, and agency revenue performance.
  • Drive measurable improvements in onboarding, activation, engagement, retention, and expansion by identifying opportunities through customer behavior, product analytics, and experimentation.
  • Partner with Data Science, Analytics, and Engineering teams to develop growth insights, customer health models, churn prediction frameworks, dashboards, and scalable measurement systems that inform product decisions.
  • Establish and scale experimentation frameworks, feedback loops, and growth mechanisms that continuously improve customer outcomes and business performance.
  • Stay ahead of evolving SaaS, AI, and customer trends, translating market insights and customer needs into differentiated product experiences and growth opportunities.
  • Own the Voice of the Customer through customer interviews, behavioral analytics, retention analysis, and segmentation research, translating insights into product strategy and roadmap priorities.
  • Influence and align stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Design, Marketing, Revenue, and Customer Success to drive coordinated execution and measurable business impact.
  • Mentor Product Managers and contribute to product management best practices, growth methodologies, and experimentation culture across the organization.

Requirements
  • 10+ years of Product Management experience with a proven track record of driving product growth and business outcomes.
  • Strong experience building and scaling SaaS products, with deep expertise in onboarding, activation, adoption, retention, and product-led growth.
  • Experience owning a product area and delivering measurable improvements in customer engagement, retention, and revenue performance.
  • Strong understanding of SaaS growth metrics, experimentation frameworks, customer lifecycle management, and KPI-driven product strategies.
  • Experience partnering with Data Science, Analytics, and Engineering teams to build measurement frameworks, customer health models, and growth insights.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate data into actionable product decisions.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders and drive alignment without direct authority.
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and leadership skills.

Nice-to-Have
  • Experience with reseller platforms, white-label SaaS products, partner ecosystems, or agency-focused software.
  • Experience serving agencies, SMBs, or platform businesses.
  • Familiarity with recurring revenue models, subscription businesses, and SaaS monetization strategies.
  • Experience building customer journey analytics, growth dashboards, and experimentation platforms.
  • Experience operating in high-scale SaaS environments.

What You'll GetStrategic Impact
  • Opportunity to own one of HighLevel's most strategic growth areas and shape the future of the Agency Revenue Suite.
  • Direct ownership of growth outcomes across SaaS Mode, Reselling, Rebilling, and agency monetization experiences.

Collaborative Culture
  • Work alongside exceptional teammates across Product, Engineering, Design, Data, Marketing, Revenue, and Customer Success.
  • Partner closely with analytics, growth, and customer-facing teams to solve complex business challenges.

Scale
  • Influence how thousands of agencies build and grow recurring revenue businesses on HighLevel.
  • Define the growth metrics, experimentation frameworks, and success models that power the next phase of platform growth.
  • Build products and experiences that impact millions of businesses globally.

Why Join HighLevel?
At HighLevel, you'll have the opportunity to define and scale one of the company's most important growth initiatives. You'll help shape how agencies build recurring revenue businesses while creating durable growth systems that drive long-term customer and business success.

Role Summary
As the Sr. Product Manager for Commerce Operations, you will own the operational backbone of HighLevel's commerce platform - the interconnected systems that govern how orders are created, tracked, and fulfilled; how subscriptions run across their full lifecycle; how transactions are recorded and reconciled; and how inventory, taxation, coupons, and gift cards function reliably at scale. Like the Product Information Management layer, this role sits at the center of the Commerce team: every commerce surface depends on it, internal teams across the company build on it, and the external developer and marketplace ecosystem consumes it through a public API layer that you will define and own. You will also lead the build of HighLevel's internal accounting layer and design the integration surface for users who operate with third-party accounting tools — positioning commerce operations as both the authoritative source of financial truth and an open, compatible platform.

What You'll Do

● Own the Commerce Operations Roadmap: Define and drive the end-to-end product vision across HighLevel's full operations surface - Orders, Subscriptions, Transactions, Inventory, Fulfillment, Taxation, Coupons, and Gift Cards — ensuring each domain is built as a composable, reliable primitive that serves the platform as a whole.

● Build the Subscription Lifecycle: Own how plans, entitlements, renewals, upgrades, downgrades, pauses, and dunning flows work across the platform - building subscription management that handles the full complexity of real SMB billing, from simple recurring charges to tiered, usage-based, and trial-gated plans.

● Define the Ledger & Internal Accounting Layer: Lead the product definition and build of HighLevel's internal accounting layer — the authoritative system of record for every money-in and money-out event - designed from day one as the foundation for embedded accounting that keeps businesses running their books inside HighLevel.

● Enable Third-Party Accounting Compatibility: Design the integration surface that allows users who prefer external accounting software to sync HighLevel commerce data seamlessly - ensuring field mapping accuracy, reconciliation reliability, and a sync experience that requires zero manual intervention.

● Own Order Management & Fulfillment: Define how orders are created, modified, fulfilled, partially fulfilled, returned, and cancelled - building the state machine and merchant-facing workflows that make order operations reliable across every commerce surface, from storefronts to invoices to subscriptions.

● Build for Variable Granularity: Ensure every operational entity - order, fulfillment event, invoice, subscription, payment — is optional and composable. A business running on invoices alone and a business running a full order-fulfillment-invoice-payment chain must both be fully supported, with frictionless paths between granularity levels.

● Lead Inventory Management: Define the inventory layer - stock levels, reservations, adjustments, multi-location support, and low-stock signals - ensuring the platform correctly tracks physical goods across the full commerce lifecycle and exposes inventory state to every consuming surface.

● Shape Taxation & Compliance Infrastructure: Own the product strategy for tax calculation, tax code mapping, and compliance — across transaction types and geographies - ensuring HighLevel handles tax obligations correctly as merchants operate in multiple regions and as the platform expands internationally.

● Define Coupons, Promotions & Gift Cards: Build the discount and gift card infrastructure - coupon creation and validation, promotion rules, gift card issuance and redemption, balance tracking - ensuring these tools are expressive enough for merchant needs while enforcing correct financial accounting at every step.

● Own the Developer & Marketplace API Surface: Define and own the public API layer that external developers, agencies, and marketplace partners consume - ensuring commerce operations APIs are well-designed, stable, versioned, and expressive enough to support the full range of third-party integration and build use cases.

● Drive Cross-Functional Platform Alignment: Collaborate with the PIM, Documents, Onboarding, and Payments teams to ensure the operations layer exposes the primitives they depend on - and that operational events such as order placement, invoice issuance, and subscription renewal trigger the correct downstream behaviors reliably and consistently.

What We're Looking For

● 7+ Years of PM Experience: Proven track record in platform or infrastructure product management at high-growth SaaS companies, with significant exposure to transactional or financial systems.

● Commerce Operations Depth: Deep familiarity with order management, subscription billing, inventory, fulfillment, and transaction or ledger systems - understanding both the underlying data models and the merchant workflows built on top of them.

● Financial Systems Fluency: Comfort reasoning about ledger mechanics, double-entry accounting concepts, reconciliation requirements, and the data integrity standards of systems that carry financial truth for real businesses.

● API & Developer Platform Thinking: Experience building and owning public APIs consumed by external developers — with a strong grasp of contract design, versioning strategies, stability guarantees, and what makes a developer experience genuinely good.

● Platform-First Mindset: Demonstrated ability to design products as shared infrastructure - defining clear contracts, managing internal teams as stakeholders, and consistently prioritizing long-term extensibility over short-term feature velocity.

● Bias for Ownership: Comfortable holding the thread across a broad, interconnected domain without letting complexity become an excuse for slow decisions. Sets direction and drives execution independently.

What you'll get

● Strategic Centrality: Own the operational core that every other commerce surface depends on - a role with platform-wide impact, visibility across every team building on HighLevel's commerce infrastructure, and a direct line to the company's system-of-record ambition.

● High Ownership, Low Bureaucracy: Join an already-assembled engineering and design team and take full ownership of a mission-critical layer, with the autonomy to define the roadmap and drive execution at the pace HighLevel operates.

● Scale: Build the operational infrastructure that powers commerce for over a million businesses across 150+ countries, and define the accounting and developer API layer that will shape how HighLevel's commerce ecosystem grows over the next decade.

title: Product Lead, Infrastructure
description:
About Supabase


Supabase is the open-source Postgres development platform that 10M+ developers and thousands of enterprises depend on every day. Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime and Vector Search all run on one platform: the same compute, the same disks, the same network and control plane, in every region we operate.

Supabase's hardest problems live in that platform. Millions of databases, growth that compounds every quarter, and a customer base running from a developer on a free project to a regulated enterprise routing traffic through PrivateLink. Reliability, capacity, cost and the enterprise features that close deals all come back to the same primitives. We're hiring a Product Lead to own them.

About the role

You own the platform primitives every Supabase product runs on: compute, disks, networking, the API gateway, capacity and regions. You own the enterprise surfaces built on top of them too, including read replicas, custom domains, PrivateLink and Bring Your Own Cloud. You report to the Head of Product and set direction for the whole area alongside the leads for our other product lines. You're the only product person on the platform today, and the team grows under you as the area does.

What you'll be responsible for:

  • You talk to customers across the full spectrum. Developers running a single small project, growing startups whose bill is mostly compute and disk, enterprises walking through a network architecture review, and partners building on top of Supabase.

  • You own the problem statement and requirements behind every platform bet. You define what we're building and why before engineering starts, name the cost, capacity and reliability constraints, and keep that clarity current through execution.

  • You decide what gets built, what gets deferred, and what gets cut. Every quarter you're choosing between enterprise unlocks that open new markets, cost and performance wins for the long tail of projects, and net-new capabilities that change what Supabase can run. The priorities are yours, and so is defending them.

  • You own reliability as a product surface. You set service levels that track what customers experience, hold teams to them, and show customers what it takes to run millions of databases.

  • You define how each launch is measured before it ships. The metric, the threshold and the read afterwards are yours: whether a launch moved enterprise deal velocity, project economics, or platform reliability.

  • You keep engineering, design and leadership aligned. The platform touches every other Supabase product, every region and every customer tier. You write down what's coming, why, and in what order, and you surface dependencies before they become blockers.

You might be a good fit if you:

  • Have 8+ years of product management experience on developer tools, or are an ex-founder who has built in this space. You're technical enough to read an architecture doc and follow a design discussion.

  • Have shipped cloud infrastructure as a product. You've owned at least one of compute, networking, storage, or multi-region and multi-tenant systems at a cloud, infrastructure or PaaS company, as the owner rather than a neighbouring team. You can judge the tradeoffs: instance sizing and capacity, disk and storage economics, scale-to-zero versus always-on, single-tenant versus shared, and the distance between "works in one region" and "works in twenty." Familiarity with how enterprises buy infrastructure (PrivateLink, BYOC, procurement) is a bonus.

  • Have grown with an infrastructure product. You've owned infrastructure small enough to hold in your head, and stayed with it until capacity, regions and cost became the real constraints.

  • Are biased toward speed. You'd rather ship something imperfect and learn from it.

  • Build with what you own. You stand up a read replica, put a custom domain in front of a project, terminate traffic through PrivateLink, deploy onto BYOC. You develop opinions through first-hand use.

  • Use AI to move faster. You lean on AI for the slow parts of the job (research, drafting, synthesising feedback) so you spend more time on judgment calls.

  • Work async by default. We're fully remote. You make decisions in writing and move work forward without meetings.

What We Offer

  • Fully Remote

    We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

  • ESOP

    Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.

  • Tech Allowance

    Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

  • Health Benefits

    Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.

  • Annual Off-Sites

    Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.

  • Flexible Work

    We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.

  • Professional Development

    Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.

About the Team

Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.

  • ~400 team members

  • 60+ countries

  • 20+ languages spoken

  • Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)

  • 540,000+ community members

We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

title: Product Manager - Security & Trust (EMEA/AMER)
description:
Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers to help them ship countless products that people love. More than 7 million developers trust us with their data, and we are custodians of every byte of it. Security is foundational to that trust, and as we move deeper into AI-native development, regulated industries, and enterprise, it shapes whether a developer chooses us on day one and whether a regulated company can build their most sensitive workloads on Supabase.

About the role

We're looking for a PM who can balance the constant tension between security and developer experience at platform scale. Every control you add is friction a developer has to absorb, and every default you loosen is a door an attacker could walk through. Finding the right balance between protecting customers and keeping them fast is the work of this role.

You'll partner with Security Engineering, Compliance, and the platform teams that own auth, networking, and audit.

This is a remote position and we're open to considering candidates located across EMEA and AMER time zones.

In This Role You Will

  • Set the security agenda for the platform. Lead Supabase's platform security roadmap end-to-end, from the defaults that protect a developer prototyping their first project to the advanced controls a Fortune 500 CISO needs before approving us.

  • Hold the line between security and developer experience. Every security feature trades protection against friction. A control that's too strict pushes developers off the platform; one that's too easy to bypass doesn't protect anyone.

  • Lead our security strategy for AI agents. Agents now read, write, and deploy on behalf of developers and companies, often at machine speed. You'll lead how Supabase authenticates, scopes, and audits agent activity so customers can give them real capability while staying in control of their data.

  • Own our security product surface. Drive the roadmap for the security tooling customers use to operate safely on Supabase: firewall, security advisors, audit logs, Supabase Vault, just-in-time database access, and the IAM primitives that let regulated customers get to "yes" with their security team.

  • Define the unified access model across Supabase. Roles, permissions, personal access tokens, OAuth integrations, organization and project modeling, SSO, and SCIM are foundational to how customers manage who can do what. You'll set the strategy that ties them together and drive the cross-cutting RFCs from proposal to shipped code.

  • Drive the compliance roadmap. Supabase already runs a strong compliance program with SOC2 and HIPAA in place. Your job is to define what comes next so more regulated companies can adopt us.

  • Be the customer's voice for security. Talk to enterprise prospects, regulated customers, and the security teams behind them. Translate what you hear into a roadmap that earns trust at every customer size, from the indie hacker prototyping their first project to the Fortune 500 CISO evaluating us for their most regulated workloads.

  • Ship the docs that go with the code. Make the security guides on supabase.com the best in the category: clear, opinionated, and trustworthy enough that a developer evaluating us comes away convinced.

You Might Be a Good Fit If You

  • Have 7+ years in product management, with serious time on security, identity and access, infrastructure, or developer platform products at a company where security mattered to enterprise buyers.

  • Have deep working knowledge of the security primitives our customers use like authentication, authorization (RBAC, RLS), audit logging, secrets management, OAuth.

  • Have a track record of leading cross-functional initiatives across Product, Engineering, Security, GTM, and Compliance, and driving multi-team RFCs from proposal to shipped code.

  • Are 100% comfortable in a remote, async, write-it-down culture.

  • Are an exceptional writer. You can draft a customer-facing security disclosure, an internal threat model, a docs page, or a one-pager for a CISO without losing voice or precision.

Nice to have

  • Compliance fluency. You've worked alongside auditors and security teams on programs like SOC2, HIPAA, ISO 27001, PCI, or FedRAMP, and you can tell which requirements are real customer needs and which are checkbox theater.

  • Technical depth in Postgres, auth systems, or networking primitives.

  • Experience designing access models for AI agents or other automated systems.

  • Shipped security features that enterprise CISOs had to approve before adoption.

What We Offer

  • Fully Remote

    We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

  • ESOP

    Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.

  • Tech Allowance

    Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

  • Health Benefits

    Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.

  • Annual Off-Sites

    Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.

  • Flexible Work

    We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.

  • Professional Development

    Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.

About the Team

Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.

  • ~400 team members

  • 60+ countries

  • 20+ languages spoken

  • Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)

  • 540,000+ community members

We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.
